Abstract logic.subject: Applied Sciences

Aponogeton madagascariensis.fact: The flowers are produced on an erect, two-pronged spike up to 1 metre (39 in) long, protruding up to 20 centimetres (7.9 in) above the water surface, with a white bract protecting each flower.
